notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta4) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.notes:
This fourth beta of the 0.1.7 release focuses on 2 training areas to learn how the player can collaborate with Woody the fox. Feel free to report any issue using the internal BugReporter, on my discord server 

https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE or on bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/deb8be90b498a11c6564574579efdb6a2bb1e1e1.png"]New features
Add a cutscene for market path now included in the demo (yet)

2 new areas to learn how to summon Woody, take control, and use his abilities

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/33c294754c076bab5c57059306bbdedec4a7069b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/3cca0244caf4eff1ffd9ddd833f22773ef92c390.png"]

Add buttons on screen (joypads and keyboard)
Changed features
A lot of elements now monitor Woody in addition to the player (stairs, interruptors, chests, coins, traps, …)

Migration of level saved files

Peagons are afraid of Woody 🙂
Bugfixes
No new bugfix included
Known issues
No known issue
Coming next
Remap keys settings

More NPC

Player will be able to start using Woody’s abilities
System and dependencies changes
None

notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta3) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.notes:
This third beta of this 0.1.7 release focuses on quality. I took care of every bug report (more than 200 !!!) you sent via the in-game bugreport. Thanks a lot for your support and feedback, it helps me a lot to improve the game.

I still need your help to report issues on this version which includes a lot of addition and modification. Feel free to report using the internal BugReporter, on my discord server https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE or on bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com


New features
Pause menu

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/98e424f13c430b414b914e9d23446db4e2cd6970.png"]

Video settings

Use OS language by default

Save game migration between versions

Interaction messages indicator now disappears after a few time

Game is saved when player gets the sword

Bugreports are now automatically added to my Notion workspace in a dedicated database
Changed features
Candle management with auto mode or one-by-one consumption

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/2dceaff36788ff5427a7775a2278d51962a577fa.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/18646b4d2c02247748b7b6d600569b76883d711b.png"]

Simplify version number displayed in production

Changed key for inventory on joypad

Changed key for next view inside inventory on PC

Add volume slider sound indicator

Enemies now turn to player when hit

New theme applied to screens (title, settings, died, …) / pause menu / bugreport

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/7ec675127c2a73a28d43195ac586bbba1a4c0deb.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/15f4e5e5a5d2ffcc59538d6c9b497028c9e13b16.png"]

Save game visual indicator

Bugreport now remembers your name
Bugfixes
Lots of bugs reported by players
Known issues
Sword is still hard to get, a new jauge system will be implemented soon
Coming next
Remap keys settings

More NPC

Player will be able to summon and take control of the collected guardian animal !
System and dependencies changes
DialogueManager updated to 3.7.1

InputHelper updated to 4.7.0

PhantomCamera updated to 0.9.3.1

notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta2) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.notes:
This second beta of the 0.1.7 release introduces a new boss (the Minotaur), a menu screen (finally!) and a brand new save system. I need your help to report issues on this version which includes a lot of addition and modification. Feel free to report using the internal BugReporter, on the discord server https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE or on bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com


New features
Minotaur boss

Title and settings screen, die screen

Player can now die

Game save, load and resume. New SaveStone to save progression manually

New language: German


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/4e349ad2f441b0bd25a25f3466f9e064e65e4b5d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/6feb30a79ce3f03200537b4e04dd962d536cd9eb.png"][/carousel]Changed features
Rework Elya story

Rework dialog balloon to automatically resize depending on text lenght

Code optimizations
Bugfixes
Font issue with some special characters

Lots of bugs 🪲
Known issues
Candle management is not optimal

Sword is still hard to get, a new jauge system will be implemented soon
Coming next
Pause screen

Video settings

Have a nice day 💌
